## Flagship: Deploying the data science taxonomy classifier

### Question
Can the taxonomy label new NIH projects automatically as they are funded, and stay accurate over time?

### Data
New NIH RePORTER projects, pulled on a schedule. [Refresh frequency]{.todo}

### Method
- Classifier served as an API on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Cloud Run
- Scheduled data refresh
- MLflow for experiment tracking and model versions
- Drift checks: compare new label distributions with the validated baseline
